author: N.G Martin, Hugo

steps.title: Homogenize liver tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize liver tissue in PBS on ice using a mortar and pestle.

steps.title: Centrifuge homogenate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate at 300 rpm for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL ATAC lysis buffer (Active Motif, catalog 105310).

steps.title: Count nuclei and aliquot
steps.instruction: Count nuclei and aliquot 5 × 10⁴ nuclei per reaction.

steps.title: Tagmentation reaction
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Tagmentation Master Mix to each reaction and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min in a Thermoshaker (Life Technologies).

steps.title: Add purification buffers
steps.instruction: Transfer samples to new tubes, add 250 µL DNA Purification Binding Buffer and 5 µL 3 M sodium acetate (no pH adjustment required).

steps.title: Purify DNA
steps.instruction: Purify DNA using the DNA purification columns supplied with the ATAC‑Seq kit.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a Qubit fluorometer (Thermo Scientific).

steps.title: Prepare sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Amplify DNA and construct libraries using the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: DNA clean‑up with SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Clean up the amplified DNA using SPRI beads at 1.2× the sample volume (kit‑provided).

steps.title: Assess library quality
steps.instruction: Evaluate library size distribution and concentration with a BioAnalyzer (Agilent).

steps.title: Sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq targeting ~50 million 150 bp paired‑end reads per library.
